summary: Cellectis S.A., a French biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, containing its interim report for the six-month period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements prepared under IAS 34, presented in U.S. dollars, along with management's discussion and analysis. It is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is purely a standard financial report with no transaction terms or strategic actions.
